decisions.reason: The existing message-539 MODIFY already limits dashboard rendering to NFTs from the active replacement contract and excludes legacy-contract NFTs.
The existing message-539 MODIFY already limits ownership and mint reporting to the active replacement contract and excludes legacy-contract NFTs.
The existing message-539 MODIFY already limits owner discovery to replacement-contract NFTs and marks legacy-contract NFTs as undiscoverable.
The existing message-539 MODIFY already limits active-system metadata to replacement-contract NFTs and excludes legacy-contract metadata.
The existing message-539 MODIFY already excludes legacy-contract activity, limits statistics to the replacement contract, and records the fresh replacement draw state.
The existing message-539 MODIFY already records that the USDC mint flow uses only the active replacement contract.
The existing message-539 INTRODUCE already captures the accepted fresh-state migration policy and exclusion of old-contract NFTs from the active system.
The contract migration and legacy-NFT access decision does not necessarily change the About-page content currently specified.

Because legacy-contract NFTs will not be used by the active system, transfer-linked book access, referral identity, badges, and ticket treatment must be scoped to NFTs from the active replacement contract.
